name: Natural Northern Foods
old_description: Try our delicious creations, naturally made in Traverse City, Michigan
about:
Natural Northern Foods operates from Traverse City, Michigan, where Lori founded the company in 2005. The business is woman-owned and operated, beginning with a fresh salsa recipe inspired by local farmer’s markets and expanding into a line of hand-made, all-natural foods.

The company produces salsa, hummus dips, cream cheese spreads, spices, rubs, and specialty items. Everything is made by hand in small batches to maintain quality control, with no preservatives added, non-GMO ingredients when available, and all products gluten-free. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed, but production occurs entirely at the Traverse City location.

Products are sold through more than 100 retail outlets across Michigan, including grocery chains such as Spartan, Family Fare, Oleson’s, and Tom’s, as well as independent markets like Burritt’s Market, Maxbauer’s Market, Oryana Stores, Edson Farms, Anderson’s Market, Galagher’s Farm Market, and Hansen Foods. The company also ships directly to consumers when items are not available locally.

Natural Northern Foods was started from a passion for creating great-tasting, whole, healthy foods without preservatives. Its stated mission emphasizes highest-quality ingredients, hand-made original recipes, small-batch production, and a commitment to non-GMO and gluten-free standards.
